preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call updateFee function
Other users must hold tokens and perform transfers for fees to be collected

exploit_hint: 1. Attacker (as owner) calls updateFee() to set txFee and/or burnFee to maximum values (e.g., 100 or close to 100). 2. Set FeeAddress to attacker's controlled address. 3. Wait for or trigger victim token transfers. 4. During transfer/transferFrom, excessive fees are calculated and sent to FeeAddress. 5. Attacker's token balance increases significantly from collected fees, draining value from transferring users.
